summary: Hardened Wire EDM with deep AI reasoning integration. PRISMIntelligenceLayer now supports 6 WEDM/EDM domains with Claude Opus-level expert prompts referencing canonical EDM physics (Klocke, Kunieda, DiBitonto, Carslaw-Jaeger). WEDMCompleteOrchestrationEngine collects AI recommendations for wire selection, pulse optimization, pass strategy, flushing, and surface integrity. Tribal knowledge is now injected for all WEDM AI reasoning. 21 tests verify the integration.
